title: Telemetry Packages Configuration
description: Container registry and package download URLs for telemetry components.

telemetry_registry.description: Container registry configuration. Leave host empty to use the cluster-wide registry.

host.description: Registry IP and port in format 'IP:port' or 'hostname:port'. Leave empty to use cluster-wide registry.

cert_path.description: Path to SSL certificate file (.crt). Required only when using HTTPS with a custom CA.

key_path.description: Path to SSL private key file (.key). Required only when using HTTPS with a custom CA.

username.description: Registry username for authenticated pull. Leave empty if no authentication is required.

telemetry_packages.description: Full HTTP/HTTPS download URLs for telemetry Helm chart tarballs and pip modules.

strimzi_kafka_operator.description: Full URL for Strimzi Kafka Operator Helm chart tarball (.tar.gz). Required when any source targets kafka.

victoria_metrics_operator.description: Full URL for VictoriaMetrics Operator Helm chart tarball (.tar.gz). Required when victoria_metrics sink is enabled.

cryptography.description: Full URL for the 'cryptography' Python pip module.

omsdk.description: Full URL for the 'omsdk' Python pip module. Required when iDRAC telemetry is enabled.

cffi.description: Full URL for the 'cffi' Python pip module.

prometheus_client.description: Full URL for the 'prometheus_client' Python pip module.

kubernetes.description: Full URL for the 'kubernetes' Python pip module.

cert_manager_tarball.description: Full URL for cert-manager Helm chart tarball. Required only when using cert-manager for Kafka TLS.

cluster_mount.description: Local mount point path on the Kubernetes cluster where telemetry packages will be staged. Must be an already-mounted NFS share path.
cluster_mount.errorMessage: cluster_mount is required and must be a non-empty path (e.g., '/opt/omnia/k8s_mount').
